mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 62 degrees with a light drizzle near the Military Ridge State Trail. We are currently under a third quarter moon, and although the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona is proud to welcome Deputy Chief Liz Gay to the EMS team. Liz brings extensive experience from South Carolina and the Midwest, having served in leadership roles and as a clinical instructor. She will focus on building relationships with our community and staff when she starts on November 2. Also, residents are reminded to visit the Pellitteri website for recycling and refuse schedules.

There is plenty of brain-teasing fun today with trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow or try Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.

In a noteworthy call from our weekly report, on October 25, officers located a 40-year-old man passed out in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue. The man was subsequently arrested for an O W I first offence.
Enjoy the delicious Turtle Cheesecake flavor of the day today. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
